# The SPF records of large mail services, recorded from live DNS for
# TestLookupSPFRealSenders (the total address-space cap must not make their
# evaluation incomplete).
#
# Recorded on 2026-10-15 with
#   dig +short TXT <name> @1.1.1.1
# for every name below: _spf.google.com (Google Workspace),
# spf.protection.outlook.com (Microsoft 365), amazonses.com (Amazon SES),
# sendgrid.net and the ab.sendgrid.net it includes (SendGrid), and
# _netblocks.google.com, _netblocks2.google.com and _netblocks3.google.com
# (the former include tree of _spf.google.com; on that date
# _spf.google.com lists its ranges itself and includes none of them).
# Every TXT record of a name is kept, the SPF record among others.
#
# Format: one TXT record per line, "<name> TXT <text>"; the
# character-strings of a record are separated by "|" (as served by the
# fake DNS server of the tests). Lines starting with "#" are comments.
